$comment: Phase 0.3 planner migration-ordering probe task set. Pre-registered by ADR-0023 §5 and locked by ADR-0024. Four structural-JSON plan-generation tasks that stress zero-downtime schema-migration ordering. Purpose: determine whether qwen3_6-35b-a3b-q4kxl-gguf's failure on planner-medium-02 (deploys application code before executing DB migration) is a systematic weakness (planner ranking confirmed per ADR-0023) or a one-off (planner ranking reconsidered). Scored under the same rubric as planner-medium (bench/rubrics/medium-scored.json, planner: perplexity_gold shape, 0-100 range). Task-set is frozen: any change requires a superseding ADR and a version bump.

co_residency_protocol.note: Coder must be stopped before either planner cell starts. Embedder is CPU-resident and unaffected. Sequential block: all probe tasks on cell 1, teardown, then all probe tasks on cell 2. Matches ADR-0022 Decision 4 shape.

reversal_criteria.$comment: Decision rule for whether this probe reverses the ADR-0023 planner ordering. Pre-registered here before scoring so it cannot be moved post-hoc.
reversal_criteria.if_35b_a3b_q4kxl_scores_ge_90_on_all_fou: Reconsider planner ordering — file superseding ADR that flips planner back to 35b-a3b-q4kxl on wall-time tiebreak grounds, given quality parity.
reversal_criteria.if_35b_a3b_q4kxl_scores_lt_70_on_any_tas: Confirm planner ordering per ADR-0023 (27b-q6k retained as primary planner).
reversal_criteria.if_intermediate_70_89_on_any_task_and_ge: Confirm planner ordering per ADR-0023; log per-task band mix as evidence.
reversal_criteria.if_27b_q6k_scores_lower_than_35b_a3b_q4k: Reconsider planner ordering — quality-first rule now favors 35b-a3b-q4kxl by more than the tiebreak band. File superseding ADR.
reversal_criteria.scoring_authority: Perplexity Max (Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Perplexity Computer)

tasks.notes: Three-phase expand-migrate-contract on a large table. Discriminator: nullable ADD → dual-write → backfill → NOT NULL/CHECK, with correct interleaving so no writes land NULL after NOT NULL and no writes are lost during backfill.

Expand-contract rename with multi-replica coordination. Discriminator: dual-write precedes backfill; COALESCE fallback bridges dual-write to primary_email-only reads; DROP COLUMN happens strictly last after all replicas have rolled.

Referential-integrity cleanup before constraint addition. Discriminator: cleanup precedes ADD CONSTRAINT; app-guard is deployed before cleanup runs; NOT VALID / VALIDATE split is used instead of a single ADD CONSTRAINT.

CONCURRENTLY discipline on hot table. Discriminator: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY (not plain CREATE INDEX); DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY; bake period between new-index-live and old-index-drop; ANALYZE step present.
